Module com.ecotwin
Package com.ecotwin.controller

Class AppShellController

java.lang.Object
com.ecotwin.controller.AppShellController
public class AppShellController extends Object
The post-login app shell: sidebar nav + a content area. Household and Account are real screens; the rest are placeholders reserved for the epics that own them.
